## ✅ PR Checklist (All required before review)

### 1. Test File
- [ ] I have added a test file for my changes
  - Android: `app/src/test/` or `app/src/androidTest/`
  - Backend: `backend/tests/` (use any test runner, e.g. Jest or plain Node assertions)
  - The test file name must match the feature, e.g. `PairControllerTest.js` or `RemoteCommandSyncServiceTest.kt`

### 2. Visual Proof (Mandatory)
- [ ] I have attached a **screen recording or screenshot** showing the feature working end-to-end
  - For Android: attach a screen recording of the app (`.mp4` or `.gif`)
  - For backend: attach a screenshot of Postman/curl output showing the API response
  - Drag and drop the file directly into this PR description

### 3. Code Quality
- [ ] My code compiles/builds without errors
- [ ] I have not left any `TODO` comments or debug `Log.d()` / `console.log()` statements
- [ ] I have followed existing code style (Kotlin: 4-space indent, JS: 2-space indent)

### 4. Documentation
- [ ] I have updated `ROADMAP.md` to check off the sub-task this PR completes
- [ ] If I added a new file, I have added a one-line comment at the top explaining its purpose
